Keep their original overlap and arrangement. The left wall contains the large dark arched fireplace with a few logs; the right wall contains the closed double doors with two round pale knobs. Along the rear wall retain exactly three tall green-lit windows with olive curtains. Preserve the dense row of mounted stylized horn and tooth trophies across the upper walls, the dark teal patterned wallpaper, green edging on the wall panels, the two visible tall potted plants, and the centered hanging light with two pale green rounded glass shades and slender curving arms.
Use the source's near-black ceiling, deep blue-green wood floor, olive curtains, burgundy chair upholstery and controlled luminous green accents. Keep the quiet dark palette readable with crisp angular television-animation linework, broad cel-painted shadows and restrained texture. No photorealistic or 3D rendering.
Composition for a 16:9 fight screen: keep the SAME lateral extent of the reference room, reduce only the empty dark ceiling region, and extend the SAME existing wooden foreground floor toward the camera. Keep the dining furniture wholly behind an unobstructed continuous lower-quarter combat strip; do not delete the table or chairs, replace the room, invent new architecture or enlarge the fireplace. Do not add dinnerware or new decorations. Preserve the supplied occlusions; no invented hidden furniture details.
Exactly one full finished empty background, all pixels opaque. No people, creatures, bodies, UI, lettering, logos, watermark, border or split panels. No detached prop overlays. Le cadrage 16:9 réduit le plafond vide et prolonge le même parquet au premier plan pour le combat, adaptation Simulation AU.
Le petit support du lustre au plafond est coupé en haut par le cadrage final ; cette limite concerne le fond, pas le prop isolé entier produit séparément par root.
Le prompt historique disait two shades : description imprécise de deux groupes aux ouvertures chevauchées. La source visuelle fait autorité ; aucune suppression de parties demandée après inspection.
